svg.title: High Magic: the factory
svg.desc: How vekna runs many casts at once: a per-user daemon holds a circle per project (queue, process slots, worktree pool), spawns casts, pools worktrees, and lets a cast enqueue or await another.
svg.text: What Reborn did for one cast, done for many. Same vekna, replicated and scaled: casts run side by side
across a pool of worktrees, rituals fan work out into a queue, and one window shows the whole of it.

g.text: Parallel between casts · steps stay sequential
a sweep fans out one cast per PR
runs at once, still counts a slot

svg.text: daemon · one per user · outlives every window
one per project — a project is its git common dir, so all its worktrees group together

g.text: spawns when what it needs is free
every cast of every project on one socket
no tree: reads the CI board
in wt-1, an agent at work
awaiting fix #29; gave its slot back
slot released, rejoins at queue head
at a decide, waiting for an answer
g every project · a <answer> a prompt
pooled per project, sized by [circle] worktrees
dirty or mid-merge → TreeBlocked, out of the pool until clean
a step decides where it carries on and where it waits
wait for its result, as output=
• the parent comes back ahead of the queue
• its tree stays leased while it waits
deadlock guard: a lease fails, not waits, when every free
tree is held by a cast awaiting one that needs a tree
the window is a view; the daemon is the place
first bare vekna starts the daemon detached
q closes the window only · vekna stop ends the daemon
running casts carry on without it
and rejoin the next daemon, keeping their slot and tree
the next daemon runs what was left queued
the numbers, per project or user-wide:
a sweep as one cast per pull request

svg.text: Not planned: pooled cast processes · anything across machines · concurrent steps in one cast · a tree reset by the daemon
